caption:
You take client calls, handle delivery, and chase invoices. Writing detailed notes after every conversation eats an hour of your afternoon. You get a clean transcript and action items without typing a word.

Paste this into ChatGPT after your call:
"Act as a client success manager. I will paste a raw Retell AI call transcript. Extract three clear action items, one client concern, and a polite follow-up email draft. Keep it under 150 words. Use bullet points. Wait for my transcript."

This works for solo consultants, freelancers, and small operators who handle their own sales and support. Check the Retell AI pricing page for current plan costs.
